items.title: Post-election gridlock might be a bullish sign for Apple,
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi explains why he views any post-midterm election moves in the AI space as a bullish signal for Apple (AAPL). Plus, who are the winners and losers from the changes in Congress?
